description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BasePage' for page object models in UI automation testing using Selenium WebDriver. It provides common functionalities such as locating elements, waiting for conditions, clicking, typing, and checking presence of elements.

classes.name: BasePage
classes.description: An abstract class providing fundamental web page interactions for UI tests.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Creates a WebDriverWait with a specified timeout (default 20 seconds).

methods.name: Visible
methods.description: Waits until the specified element is visible on the page.

methods.name: Clickable
methods.description: Waits until the specified element is clickable.

methods.name: Click
methods.description: Clicks on an element identified by the locator.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Locates an element and types the given value into it after clearing.

methods.name: IsPresent
methods.description: Checks if an element is present in the DOM.
